scope: 57 existing cafe branches in Spot; exact venue photography only
limitations: Commons API name search stopped when 429 appeared; 32 successful searches retained. Geographic candidate review covers all 57 branch IDs; 24 plausible previews were visually inspected. This is not a claim that no licensed images exist anywhere.

Openverse timeouts are recorded as unavailable checks, not zero results. The broad Marrone Rosso query returned 240 Italian colour-word matches; only the first 20 metadata results were inspected, all unrelated to Astana.
Photos from Google/2GIS/Yandex/Tripadvisor were not scraped or copied; generic photos were not substituted.

accepted.title: File:Esil District, Astana (P1190756).jpg
accepted.matchEvidence: Visually inspected the 960px Commons preview: the Drinkit wordmark and 'кофейня' sign are clearly visible on the ground-floor corner facade at Бухар жырау, 28Б. Commons camera coordinates 51.100961, 71.418616 are about 58m east of the OSM cafe 51.1008453, 71.4178111, facing that exact corner facade. Image is Matti Blume's own work dated 2024-08-18, with explicit CC BY-SA 4.0 metadata. The match uses the visible brand and facade together with coordinates; proximity alone was not used.

accepted.title: File:Esil District, Astana (P1190644).jpg
accepted.matchEvidence: Visually inspected the full 960px Commons preview. The MADO facade and large blue MADO sign, plus MADO-branded terrace windows, are clearly visible behind a parked car. The camera at 51.128080, 71.435621 is about 63m southeast of the OSM Mado branch at 51.128348, 71.4348209 and points at that facade. This is a real exterior/street photograph with a car in the foreground, not an interior image. Commons metadata explicitly identifies Matti Blume as author and CC BY-SA 4.0 as the license.
